replacements.>El modelo no predice una frase completa: >The model does not predict a whole sentence: it scores the next token conditioned on the entire prefix
replacements.>En entrenamiento conocemos el token cor: >During training, the correct token is known and its log-loss is minimized. During generation there is no given answer: the distribution is turned into a choice, and that token becomes part of the next context.
replacements.>El Transformer produce una representaci: >The Transformer produces a representation for the position that must continue the sequence.</small>
replacements.>Las barras son ilustrativas: muestran o: >The bars are illustrative: they show relative ordering, not measured probabilities from a specific model.
replacements.aria-label=\"Pérdida de lenguaje: menos: aria-label="Language-model loss: negative sum of the log probability of the true token conditioned on previous tokens"
replacements.>Si el token real recibe poca probabilid: >If the true token receives low probability, the loss increases and the gradient updates the parameters.</small>
replacements.>Greedy, temperatura, top-p u otras regl: >Greedy decoding, temperature, top-p, and other rules change how the token is selected; they do not change the fact that the distribution is recomputed at every step.</small>
replacements.>Optimizar probabilidad de continuación: >Optimizing continuation probability is not the same as verifying truth. Factuality needs additional signals, data, or checks.
